speaker: Doctor
text: Does the rash extend into the eyebrows or behind the ears, and have you noticed any cradle cap or greasy scales on the scalp? I would also like to check if there are any similar rashes in the diaper area or skin folds.

text: My main symptom is Rash on scalp and forehead. I also have Erythematous patches, Greasy yellow scales, Worse in cold weather.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the greasy yellow scales and the patient's age, this presentation is classic for infantile seborrheic dermatitis. To confirm the extent of involvement, does the rash also affect the diaper area or skin folds like the neck and armpits?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Premature birth (36 weeks), otherwise generally healthy. Family history of psoriasis. Social history: The patient is 3 months old, so the social history is not applicable.

speaker: Doctor
text: The greasy yellow scales and age are highly suggestive of seborrheic dermatitis, but the family history of psoriasis warrants caution. I will request images to better evaluate the morphology of the plaques and distinguish between the two conditions. REQUEST IMAGES
